svg.title: internal-api v1.0 telemetry from the workload to the SIEM (dark)
svg.text: Telemetry · from the workload to the SIEM
internal-api v1.0 · what moves, who owns each hop, where retention and classification change

g.text: Reading order: left to right. Stages are ownership boundaries: the app team owns emit and collect, SRE owns forward, store and act. Nothing here is built by the workload except the log schema it emits.
Not drawn on purpose: Azure Monitor internals, Sentinel analytics rule content, the alerting channels (paging, chat), workbooks.
